description: Server-side entry point for handling HTTP requests in a Remix application, rendering React components to streams, and managing server responses with support for bots and browsers.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Main function to handle incoming HTTP requests, distinguish between bot and browser, and delegate to appropriate handlers.

methods.name: handleBotRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for bot requests, streaming the React app to the response.

methods.name: handleBrowserRequest
methods.description: Handles server-side rendering for browser requests, streaming the React app to the response.
